name: eve-trading
description: EVE Online player-capital skill bundle: hybrid station trading (buy orders at a low-fee Perimeter structure, sell orders at Jita 4-4 — new position selection, portfolio review, inventory risk, daily close), industry (price_build build-margin verification, production review, BPO candidate selection, ME/TE knowledge), and ship fitting (SDE-verified hull data, hull-bonus-driven design, role-coherent tank/range). Three independently-triggered skills — eve-trading, eve-industry, eve-fitting — sharing one plugin so a single install covers all of it. Use with the eve-sde-mcp SDE/ESI tools.
